description: tfl-eval deep replay, reg-04: (ab)*a | b is regular. ir-builder validates the IR, main builds the minimal DFA from the IR's own regex (regex_to_dfa(ir=...); VERDICT_POLICY §1 verified needs a human-approved IR, and the eval run auto-approves HITL 1, so it is a bounded check, 0.85) and compares it with the IR oracle (dfa_vs_ir), then submits.

(ab)*a | b
